scope: Original public mechanics prototype. No private story material.

tasks.title: Pinned A-Frame scene and same-origin assets
tasks.gate: Renderer starts and all runtime requests stay same-origin.

tasks.title: Two-hand draw, nock and pose-loss cancellation
tasks.gate: Real controller poses produce direction and power; losses never fire a stale arrow.

tasks.title: Swept arrows, cover and limited special ammunition
tasks.gate: Hits stop at nearest geometry and ammo changes only on valid shots.

tasks.title: Blink arrows and opt-in stick locomotion
tasks.gate: Shared projectile/preview first-hit collision; a widened upper-gallery target. A clear preview is not automatic aiming or permission to pass through solids.

tasks.title: Connected seeded cloisters and branching paths
tasks.gate: Seeded nonuniform extents and varying floorplans on a connected bounded nine-room graph. Same seed/depth reproduces a layout; not an unbounded streamed city.

tasks.title: Wardens, beacon, blessings and local renown
tasks.gate: An ordinary-input mission reaches the next sector; completion cannot be banked twice.

tasks.title: Spatial pause, handedness and shorter draw
tasks.gate: All essential actions can be completed in-headset, with cancelled inputs on transitions.

tasks.title: Quest 3 bow alignment and physical draw feel
tasks.gate: Record actual headset/browser version and both handedness tests. No API fixture substitutes.

tasks.title: Quest 3 sustained rendering and comfort
tasks.gate: Measure frame-time distribution, draw calls, thermal behavior, floor and snap turning on hardware.

tasks.title: Real Xbox and touch controllers
tasks.gate: Pair, reconnect, suspend and resume real USB/Bluetooth controllers and a phone.

tasks.title: Six room families, reversible skywalk and two-level belfry
tasks.gate: Nonuniform dimensions and cross-shaped plans; real stair/deck clearance. Model/native/public receipts are separate gates. Nine logical sector slots remain.

tasks.title: Crossbow, deliberate timed reload and independent weapon model
tasks.gate: Real loaded/empty state and button/stick-click reload. A physical reload gesture remains future work; hardware comfort is unverified.

tasks.title: Shield weak points and coordinated enemy behavior
tasks.gate: Enemies communicate intent without unavoidable or offscreen damage.

tasks.title: Refined original creatures, bow animation and spatial audio
tasks.gate: Finished foreground bow/hand and animated creature assets, consistent with the material-authored world. Environmental art improvement is not character-art completion.

tasks.title: Save/resume a full run and broader unlocks
tasks.gate: Versioned bounded storage restores a run without duplicating rewards.

tasks.title: Player evaluation of difficulty and enjoyment
tasks.gate: Record first-run usability, fatigue and repeat-play feedback; counts do not certify fun.

tasks.title: Optional opt-in challenge sharing
tasks.gate: No accounts or remote data until explicitly designed and authorized.

tasks.title: Directional Wardglass shield, break and recovery
tasks.gate: Front-face swept blocking before body impact; side/rear exposure, guard cost, tracking cancellation and no simultaneous firing.

tasks.title: Regenerating supported-ground shard steps
tasks.gate: Short unobstructed microdashes, no cliff crossing or tunneling. Physical thrown-shard gestures are not implemented.

tasks.title: Limited three-arrow Volley and precision hits
tasks.gate: Three independent projectiles consume one charge; actual weak-point hits earn counters.

tasks.title: Permanent Chronicle milestones and optional Nightfall
tasks.gate: Idempotent run-counter banking, retained legacy purchases, no practice farming and new-run application.

tasks.title: Twilight/daylight, original equipment and quiet synthetic ambience
tasks.gate: Local reused geometry and opt-in sound. No borrowed audio or hardware performance claim.

tasks.title: Complete scored expedition and new-device acceptance
tasks.gate: Preserve exact native reports and full-beacon/blessing/reload progression evidence; passing models alone are insufficient.

tasks.title: Physical thrown shard and richer vertical route families
tasks.gate: Readable trajectories, safe valid landings, comfortable two-handed controls and alternative routes; no forced headset motion.

tasks.title: Physical crossbow wind/reload gesture
tasks.gate: Separate comfortable interaction for both handedness settings, with an accessible button alternative.

tasks.title: Hollow Hunt: committed cantor volleys, hound charges and sentinel guard
tasks.gate: Shared physical projectiles/collision, visible warning, dodge/block/counterplay, no homing charge.

tasks.title: Two optional double-stair loft loops and elevation-gated caches
tasks.gate: Preserve ground graph links; walk both stairways and collect upper supply only at its elevation.

tasks.title: Three repeatable adversary trials and field guide
tasks.gate: Ordinary menus spawn real AI. Trial counters never change the Chronicle or prior purchases.

tasks.title: Surface-triggered Cinder bursts and interrupting Frost
tasks.gate: Cover occludes area damage; freeze interrupts charges and has a shorter sentinel duration.

tasks.title: Physical thrown-shard and crossbow winding gestures
tasks.gate: Retain accessible button alternatives; headset motion must be tested physically before release.

tasks.title: CC0 castle masonry, cobbles and finished marble sculpture
tasks.gate: Local 1K material maps and embedded 512px GLB textures; author/source/license/transform/hash register; no runtime CDN.

tasks.title: Inter-room upper loop and 6.4m belfry reliquaries
tasks.gate: One-time, elevation-gated score/heal rewards, reversible traversal and ground alternatives. Trial play cannot farm permanent rewards.

tasks.title: Continuous arch profiles, roof silhouettes and spatial material batches
tasks.gate: Matching actual before/after frames; static shadows refreshed on rebuild rather than each frame. Physical Quest performance remains unmeasured.

tasks.title: Scaled floorplan atlas with upper route and reward cues
tasks.gate: Use actual room outlines, gold skywalk and reliquary markers. No player steering or auto-completion.

tasks.title: Authored crypt/roof transitions and expanded graph vocabulary
tasks.gate: Move beyond nine logical slots while reserving doors, stair clearances, loot access and recovery routes.

tasks.title: Hardware and human review of the material-rich vertical world
tasks.gate: Quest 3 controller/floor calibration, sustained frame times, memory, comfort and whether players find the climbs worthwhile. API emulation cannot close this gate.

tasks.title: Jewelglass material profiles, carved recurve and bounded spell shaders
tasks.gate: Native material, rebuild and emulated stereo tests plus actual served-file verification.

tasks.title: Measure physical Quest 3 stereo frame times for jewel reflections and shaders
tasks.gate: Measure on device; never infer FPS, comfort or controller alignment from headless emulation.
